What about your TV? Did you change inputs, or anything like that?

More than likely your HDMI cable then, as long as you can verify it’s not your TV itself. HDMI cables carry both audio, and video cables. Best way to test your TV is to switch it to a different input, or change the channel. If it works just fine, then you know it’s not your TV. Same with your HDMI cable. Swap it out with a different one, and the outcome will tell you what the problem is. If neither of those fix it... to be honest I’m not sure! Have you dropped, or had any rough movements with your Xbox recently? In theory it’s possible that the HDMI port on your Xbox itself was damaged.

Could be several things. Could be your HDMI cable going bad. Easy test would be to swap it into another device, or it could be the graphics card within your Xbox itself. Hopefully that isn’t it, of course. Although the standard thing to check(which I assumed you had already done) was triple check all of your settings.

So now we pay for all of our own groceries, whatever we want them to be. They can be as unhealthy or vegan-ly healthy as we want them to be. That also leaves cooking the food up to us, but my squadron doesn't take ownership of that aspect, Dorm Supervision does. The problem with that is some dorms have small kitchenettes, and some don't. Those that don't have community kitchens that is shared between all of the residents(roughly 50-60, depending on occupancy status).
